text.tspan: Every list read: a list resource (ARTICLE,
awesome-list) and its text for the list index;
its entries join the pass (lists read left out)

g.text: ProductLinks: first link of an entry, outside GitHub

text.tspan: CategoryMatcher: heading path as an input,
each heading alone (id or words; never
health or legal alone); at most 12 tags
IndexAwesomeLists: after a list's entries are written,
assign their categories again; ResourceStore reads
Lists left wait for the next pass
not archived, not a fork, 50+ stars,
AI words in name, description, topics?
For each entry that points at a list
(name says awesome, or a section of lists)
https, a public name: no IP, user info,
Product site, no query, no fragment;
or join the OPEN item of the site
of the site, if one waits
